title: Codiff Configuration
description: Configuration file for Codiff. Supports JSON and JSONC (JSON with Comments).

$schema.description: Path to the JSON schema for editor autocompletion.

agentBackend.description: Which agent CLI powers review assistance and walkthroughs. 'codex' uses the OpenAI Codex CLI; 'claude' uses the Claude Code CLI; 'opencode' uses the OpenCode CLI; 'pi' uses the Pi CLI.

autoViewedPatterns.description: Paths that need no review attention of their own, as gitignore-flavoured globs (for example "**/*.test.ts" or "**/__tests__/**"). Supports **, *, ?, a leading / to anchor at the repository root, a trailing / for a directory, and a leading ! to re-include something an earlier pattern swept up; later patterns win. Matching files start marked viewed, and the walkthrough is told to keep them off the main path unless a test contradicts the code it covers. Applies to every repository.

autoViewedSync.description: Whether files marked viewed by autoViewedPatterns are pushed to the review host alongside the ones you mark yourself. 'ask' prompts the first time it would write, then records your answer here.

checkForUpdates.description: Check GitHub Releases once a day for a newer Codiff version and show an update notification. Set to false if updates are centrally managed.

claudeEffort.description: How hard Claude Code thinks about review assistance and walkthroughs when agentBackend is 'claude'. Leave empty to inherit whatever Claude Code itself is configured to use, including the effortLevel and per-model overrides in ~/.claude/settings.json. Setting a value here overrides those. Higher levels produce better grouping on large diffs and take longer; a walkthrough that times out at 'max' may complete at 'high'.

claudeModel.description: The Claude Code model to use for review assistance and walkthroughs when agentBackend is 'claude'.

codexEffort.description: Reasoning effort for Codex review assistance and walkthroughs when agentBackend is 'codex'. Passed through as model_reasoning_effort.

codeFontFamily.description: CSS font family name used for diff and code rendering. Leave empty to use Codiff's bundled mono stack.

codeFontSize.description: Font size in pixels used for diff and code rendering.

copyCommentsOnClose.description: Copy pending review comments to clipboard when closing a window.

diffStyle.description: Diff layout style. 'split' shows deleted and added lines side by side; 'unified' shows them in one column.

editorCommand.description: Command used to open files from Codiff. Use {file} as the file path placeholder, {line} as the optional line number, and {repo} as the repository root placeholder, for example "subl \"{repo}\" \"{file}\"", or leave empty to use Codiff's default editor lookup.

lastRepositoryPath.description: The last repository opened by Codiff when no path was explicitly provided.

openAIModel.description: The OpenAI model to use for review assistance and walkthroughs.

opencodeModel.description: The OpenCode model to use for review assistance, walkthroughs, and the managed /codiff command when agentBackend is 'opencode'. Use 'opencode-default' to preserve OpenCode's configured default, or a provider-qualified model id such as 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6'.

piModel.description: The Pi model to use for review assistance and walkthroughs when agentBackend is 'pi'.

reviewCommentsPrefix.description: Markdown prefix prepended to copied review comments. Set to an empty string to omit the heading entirely.

sidebarPosition.description: Side of the desktop window where the file sidebar appears.

showOutdated.description: Show review comments anchored to outdated diff lines. Hidden by default, matching GitHub's review UI.

showWhitespace.description: Show whitespace-only changes in diffs and file line counts.

theme.description: Application color theme. 'system' follows OS preference.

walkthroughPrompt.description: Additional instructions appended to generated walkthrough prompts. Use this to request a language, tone, or level of detail while Codiff keeps its walkthrough guide, hunk ids, review-order constraints, and schema.

wordWrap.description: Wrap long diff lines instead of using horizontal scrolling.

keymap.description: Keyboard shortcut overrides for in-app actions. Use 'Mod' for Cmd on macOS and Ctrl on other platforms.

copyComments.description: Copy every review comment you have written on this diff, posted or not, as one Markdown block.

fileFilter.description: Focus the file filter search input in the sidebar.

nextHunk.description: Jump to the next hunk or review comment. Accepts a single combo or a list of aliases.

prevHunk.description: Jump to the previous hunk or review comment. Accepts a single combo or a list of aliases.

nextSearchMatch.description: Navigate to the next search match.

openFile.description: Open the currently selected file in the configured editor.

prevSearchMatch.description: Navigate to the previous search match.

shortcutsHelp.description: Hold to show the keyboard shortcut overlay.

submitComment.description: Add the review comment being written, submitting it remotely when the review source supports it.

askAgent.description: Ask the configured agent about the review comment being written.

toggleSidebar.description: Toggle the sidebar between expanded and collapsed states.

toggleWordWrap.description: Toggle word wrap for long diff lines.
